name_ar: تفخيم الألف بعد الراء غير المقللة
definition: The alef is heavy after a ra that is not inclined (ولو ترى). The book names only التوراة as a word with taqlil after a ra, so the alef after any other ra is heavy.
limitations: Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
Only Book A is cited; the printed page is where the section begins and needs proofreading.
The ra is called 'not inclined' because the book lists no other word with taqlil after a ra. The imala of هار puts the inclined alef before the ra, so it does not touch this rule.
Second citation: the longer book Nabhan, which Book A digests. It agrees with the paraphrase, so it shows where the text is found, not an independent confirmation.

conditions.description: The alef follows a ra that has a fatha.
